text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's no good... At this rate... Bright<n>will—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It's good to see you hard at work,<n>Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, you should stop for now.<n>That fear
building up inside of you<n>cannot be easily shaken
off, no<n>matter how desperately you may try.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-I'm not scared!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't underestimate my<n>assessment. Precisely
how much of<n>your running do you think I've
observed up to now?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What's frightening you so much?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I can't stop shaking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I can still hear the crowd's cheers<n>from when I
crossed the finish line at<n>the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
When I realized how many voices<n>there were and
how many eyes were<n>fixed on me, watching my
every<n>move...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Memories from the past suddenly<n>flooded my
mind...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And it was like I was once again that<n>little girl,
crying and sobbing as she<n>ran...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, that scene just<n>keeps replaying in
my mind, and I<n>can't help but start shaking...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I won't be able to<n>compete in the
Japanese Oaks! I've<n>worked so hard to get to this
point,<n>and yet! And yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm so scared! I'm scared I'll revert<n>to my past
self in front of everyone...<n>and in front of Bright...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Is that truly what you fear?
...Huh?

Is what you truly fear the possibility<n>that you'll
revert to your former self?<n>Do you truly think
trembling will stop<n>you from competing?

Those are terrifying prospects indeed.<n>But I think
your true fear lies<n>elsewhere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: My true fear?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
When I was competing in the<n>Japanese Oaks, I felt
the same fear<n>you are likely experiencing now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You did?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As the Japanese Oaks drew closer, I<n>felt an
immense pressure weighing<n>down on me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I felt I had to become my ideal self no<n>matter what. I
had to fulfill the dreams<n>of those who wished to
see me<n>accomplish what my mother had.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The more I felt that I absolutely could<n>not lose, the
more I froze with fear. I<n>was terrified I wouldn't
accomplish<n>that dream or reach that ideal.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, I was eventually able to<n>shift my
perspective on that fear.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I pondered the origin of that anxiety,<n>and that was
when I had an<n>epiphany.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The fact that I was even harboring<n>such fears
proves that there are<n>people expecting great things
from<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And... they only do so because I<n>continuously
challenge myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I will ask you once more, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What is it you fear? What is it you are<n>truly afraid
of?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (I see now... The thing I'm really<n>afraid of—)

text_block_list.name: Male Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
That was incredible, Mejiro Dober!<n>Do your best at
the Japanese Oaks<n>too!

text_block_list.name: Female Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
Dober! You were so cool! I'll come<n>see you at the
Japanese Oaks for<n>sure!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Now then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Take my hand, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I'm afraid of letting Bright and<n>everyone else
down by betraying<n>their expectations...)

(But I'm only afraid of that because<n>there are
people who believe in me...)

(And because I'm trying so hard to<n>push myself
toward even greater<n>heights!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh. It seems you've reached the<n>same conclusion
I did.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To look at it differently, the source of<n>your fear is
actually what brought you<n>all this way.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Should you ever find yourself bereft<n>of confidence
and frozen in place,<n>listen to the words of those
who<n>believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am certain you can do this. After all,<n>Ryan and
Bright believe in you, as do<n>I...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And your trainer as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: All of you... believe in me... Even my<n>trainer...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to your<n>performance at the
Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I haven't managed to<n>stop my
shaking...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Despite knowing the real reason why<n>I shake, I'm
still scared. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run in the Japanese<n>Oaks for all the
people that expect<n>greatness from me!
choice_data_list: Let me carry some of your fear too.
Let me carry some of your fear too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind. From now on,<n>I will believe
in her more than anyone<n>else, and my cheers for
her will be<n>louder than the rest.
choice_data_list: Your battle is mine to fight too.
Your battle is mine to fight too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Why do you always spew such<n>embarrassing
stuff? Honestly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer, why are you always so...<n>Still...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She mutters the rest of her thoughts<n>in such a small
voice that they're<n>swallowed up by the night air.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She mutters the rest of her thoughts<n>in such a small
voice that they're<n>swallowed up by the night air.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
However, I can tell by the determined<n>light shining
in her eyes that Mejiro<n>Dober is back in fighting
form.
